en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 7. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Ja’far ibn Bashīr, from Ḥammād, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Zurārah, who said: Abū Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.))

asked, “What is the distance between you and the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.)?” I replied, “Sixteen or seventeen parasangs.” Imam (a.s.) asked, “Do you not go to him?” I replied, “No.” Imam (a.s.) said, “How negligent you (people) are!!!”
